order: V8-003 §1 (owner-designated investigation of one issuer through the bounded ingestion path)
criteria_source: v8/V8-001/real_data_selection_criteria.md (all six required; the criteria are applied as written, not loosened)

issuer.name: MICROCHIP TECHNOLOGY INC
issuer.commitment: consolidated net sales, June 2025 quarter = Q1 FY2026 (2025-04-01..2025-06-30), USD, GAAP (net sales carry no non-GAAP adjustment in the outlook table)

ingestion.tool: python3 -m v8.workbench.ingest (v8/workbench/ingest.py; command-line only, never imported by the server)
ingestion.records: v8/V8-003/sources/*.source.json + *.provenance.json (original bytes and the press-release passage text stay in the private ingestion record; digests here)

revision.availability_basis: publisher dateline 'May 29, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE)' and page meta published_time=2025-05-29; no clock time stated by the source; end of that day America/New_York (EDT) applied so the replay never shows it earlier than it was; no 8-K carried this release (EDGAR submissions feed checked: 8-Ks on 2025-05-02, 05-08, 08-07, 08-20 only)

source_lead_check.original: USD 1.020–1.070 billion — matches the passage ('between $1.020 billion and $1.070 billion' in the outlook table; the narrative sentence writes $1.02/$1.07)
source_lead_check.discrepancy: the May 29, 2025 press release restates the May 8 guidance as $1.025–$1.070 billion; the May 8 filing states $1.020–$1.070 billion. Both are preserved as stated (source_discrepancy note on revision R1; both passages registered verbatim); neither source is rewritten and no correction is invented

1_in_v7_corpus_with_guidance_object.evidence: v3/evidence/corpus_snapshot.json.gz (generated 2026-08-06T01:06:08Z) contains no name MCHP / CIK 827054; the sources were ingested for this order, not taken from the corpus

2_numeric_range_currency_period_basis_in.evidence: the May 8, 2025 8-K EX-99.1 states 'between $1.020 billion and $1.070 billion' for 'Net Sales' in the Fiscal Year 2026 outlook table and 'in the June 2025 quarter' in the narrative; currency USD explicit; period explicit; basis: the outlook table names GAAP and Non-GAAP columns and lists Net Sales as a single unadjusted line (GAAP); the typed claim records basis GAAP

3_comparable_outcome_inside_corpus_windo.evidence: a comparable actual exists in the ingested sources (8-K EX-99.1 of 2025-08-07: 'Net sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 were $1.0755 billion'), but not inside the v7 corpus window — the issuer is not in the corpus (criterion 1)

4_point_in_time_clean.evidence: availability comes from EDGAR acceptance times (05-08 20:17:05Z, 08-07 20:20:13Z) and, for the press release, the publisher dateline taken at end of day America/New_York (2025-05-30T03:59:59Z; no clock time stated; nothing is shown earlier than it was); every source was first observed by this workspace on 2026-09-15, after the outcome was public, so the replay is a reconstruction labeled RETROSPECTIVE REPLAY in the workbench, not a contemporaneous record

5_no_custody_or_denylist_conflict.evidence: MCHP is not in the Canada Resources evidence-only tier; tools/check_leak_sweep.py run over the tracked records (see the V8-003 checks table)

6_one_issuer_one_claim_chain.evidence: one claim (MCHP-Q1FY2026-NETSALES-GUIDE), one revision (R1), one outcome

exclusions_checked.restatement_inside_window: none found in the three sources

why_not: criterion 1 fails: the issuer is not in the v7 evidence corpus (the criteria require an already-corpus issuer; nothing was added to the corpus)
criterion 3 fails as written: the comparable outcome is an ingested source, not a corpus filing
criterion 4: the replay is retrospective (observed 2026-09-15); availability timestamps are sourced, but the observation is not contemporaneous
what_was_demonstrated: accepted real-source behaviour of the workbench on these three ingested sources — registration by typed passage with digest agreement, typed claim, comparison with the preserved discrepancy, exact calculation (OUT_OF_RANGE both ways), retrospective-labeled as-of history, simulated adjudication, rights-filtered export verified in a fresh workspace — recorded in v8/V8-003/scorecard_mchp.json. This is a behaviour demonstration on real sources, not a validated dataset and not a real-data quality claim; fixture validation, real-data quality and human benefit remain three separate questions
not_advice: Research and education only. Not investment advice.
